bagPolicy.summary: Large bags, backpacks, and similar items are strictly prohibited at the XL Center. Handbags of normal size may be allowed after a search.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Parking is available around the PeoplesBank Arena and throughout Downtown Hartford, with 45 lots and garages. Prices vary and are managed by third-party companies. Metered street parking is free from 6:00 pm to 8:00 am and all day on weekends.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in XL Center's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: The XL Center offers a diverse range of food and drink options, including New England Style Barbeque, specialty baked potatoes, and unique pizza flavors like Peanut Butter & Bacon. Visitors can enjoy a variety of beverages from local craft beers to mixed drinks and soft drinks.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by XL Center, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in XL Center's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at XL Center. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at XL Center. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
